contact.method: Clip released mesh triangles to the current CAD bumper vertical span and width, then use the nearest non-overlapping front/rear contact face.

search.criterion: Maximize both wall tags, then at least one tag across both alliances; tie-break on worst pixel margin of unoccluded tags. Sampled search, not a physical optimum.

limitations: Positions A/B/C are geometry-defined as requested, not logged shooting locations. Contact poses are static; perturbations can cross the contact boundary and are optical sensitivity cases, not collision-free driving poses.
Left-camera side follows user correction. Lens center and nominal 82 x 56.2 degree optics are approximations; current CAD orientation is pitch 27.5 up and yaw 180.

Any blocked point in a 3 x 3 tag sample grid excludes that tag; field geometry is exact released mesh. Robot and earlier static shooter mesh exclude wiring, mounts not present in the snapshot, flex, and mechanism sweep.
Candidate yaw is a visibility search with fixed position and pitch; no CAD angle is changed. Actual PhotonVision results are recorded separately.
